headline.slogan: Their first step is your biggest decision!

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: We believe childcare is more than a service — it's an experience that shapes families' lives. That's why we're redefining it by combining technology with human values, offering smart solutions that bring peace of mind and give every child a strong, confident start.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: We aim to be more than a platform — a trusted companion for every family seeking the best care. We connect families with top nurseries and rehab centers, offering a smooth, reassuring experience that makes finding the right environment easier, safer, and more comforting.

hero.title: Your Smart Platform for Your Child's Future
hero.description: A smart platform that brings families, educational centers, and rehabilitation centers together to facilitate choosing the most suitable environment for children's growth through reliable information and smart tools.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: We strive to be the leading digital destination in the Kingdom to support the early childhood sector, providing a perfect start for every child towards a bright future.

story.title: Our Story

centers.title: For Centers
centers.description: We provide a unified platform that enables centers to focus on education quality while we handle administrative and marketing aspects.

children.title: For Children
children.description: We believe in the right of every child to have a safe, stimulating educational environment that contributes to their comprehensive growth and integrated development.

families.title: For Families
families.description: We help parents find the best educational centers suited to their children's needs through comprehensive and reliable information.

story.footer: First Step was founded with a clear vision: to transform the experience of searching for educational centers from a complex, confusing process into a smooth, reliable journey. We strive to build a bridge of trust between families and educational centers across the Kingdom.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Empowering centers and families through a unified smart platform that provides advanced administrative tools and reliable information to support making the best educational decisions.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Us?
whyUs.subtitle: We understand the challenges faced by families and educational centers

movement.title: Children Moving Between Centers
movement.description: A lack of clear information causes children to move between centers multiple times. Between 25% and 40% of children transfer within the first two years due to a gap between expectations and reality. This significantly affects the child's psychological and social development.

transfer.title: Transfer Rates
transfer.description: 25%-40% of children change centers in the first two years due to unmet expectations.

confusion.title: Parents' Confusion
confusion.description: Choosing the first educational center is a major decision for many families, often made amidst unclear information and incomplete reviews. Over 70% of families search online and fail to find enough information to decide for their child.

challenges.title: Centers' Challenges
challenges.description: On the other hand, distinguished centers struggle to reach suitable families, wasting substantial time on administrative work rather than focusing on the quality of care.

bridge.title: The Bridge Connecting Families to Educational Centers
bridge.description: We build a bridge of trust and transparency between families and centers through clear information, smart tools, and a professional digital experience. This empowers centers to provide the best possible care and gives families the confidence that their educational decision is based on true understanding and complete clarity.

centers.title: Organizing the Daily Routine
